# WayneFlow

> WayneFlow is a done-for-you B2B appointment setting agency serving companies in all 50 U.S. states. We run cold email and LinkedIn outreach and book qualified sales appointments into clients' calendars, with a guarantee of 25 qualified appointments a month once a campaign is live.

## Key facts
- Results across campaigns: 588,000+ emails sent, 12,900+ replies, 3,400+ interested buyers, 100+ calls and demos booked, 6 annual contracts signed, $510K+ pipeline generated.
- Reply rates of 2.8% to 4% versus a typical 1%; bounce rates under 3%; open tracking switched off to protect deliverability.
- Separate sending domains so a client's main domain is never at risk. CAN-SPAM compliant.
- Industries: marketing agencies, B2B SaaS, construction software, professional services, founder and investor outreach.
- Book a call: https://calendly.com/learnwithasimshah/1-1-meeting-with-one-of-the-top-email-marketers
- Contact: info@wayneflow.com

- [Cold Email Deliverability in 2026: How to Land in the Inbox, Not Spam](https://wayne-flow.site/blog/cold-email-deliverability.html): The exact Gmail, Yahoo and Outlook sender rules, plus the setup, warmup, list hygiene and monitoring habits that keep cold email out of spam. Backed by numbers from 588,000 emails we have sent.
- [How to Write a Cold Email That Gets Replies: A 2026 Playbook (With Real Numbers)](https://wayne-flow.site/blog/how-to-write-a-cold-email.html): A practitioner's playbook on how to write a cold email that gets replies, built on 588,000 emails we have sent. Covers targeting, anatomy, CTAs, follow-ups, testing and realistic reply rates.
- [Outsourced Appointment Setting vs In-House SDR: The Real 2026 Cost Breakdown](https://wayne-flow.site/blog/outsourced-appointment-setting-vs-in-house-sdr.html): A sourced, line-by-line look at what one U.S. SDR really costs in year one, how to calculate cost per meeting, and when an agency, an in-house hire or a hybrid makes sense.
- [Is Cold Email Legal in the U.S.? CAN-SPAM Explained for B2B Teams (2026)](https://wayne-flow.site/blog/is-cold-email-legal.html): Cold email is legal in the U.S. when it follows the CAN-SPAM Act. Here is what the law requires of B2B teams in 2026, from opt-outs and postal addresses to penalties, state laws, and a compliance checklist.
- [Is Cold Email Legal in Canada? A CASL Guide for B2B Teams (2026)](https://wayne-flow.site/blog/is-cold-email-legal-in-canada.html): Cold email to Canada is legal only with express or implied consent under CASL. Here is what B2B teams need to know about conspicuous publication, unsubscribe rules, record keeping, penalties and how CASL compares with CAN-SPAM.
